title: Crispy Double-Fried French Fries
instructions: Peel the potatoes and keep them submerged in water while preparing them. Cut them into evenly sized sticks about 6 mm (0.25 inch) thick.
Rinse the potato sticks under cold water, then soak them in ice water for at least 90 minutes.
Drain the potatoes and dry them thoroughly with paper towels. Refrigerate them for another 90 minutes to help them firm up.
Heat the vegetable oil to 135°C. Fry the potato sticks for exactly 3 minutes, working in batches if necessary.
Drain the fries and spread them in a single layer on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Freeze for 2–3 hours. They can also be prepared and frozen several days in advance.
Heat the oil to 200°C. Fry the frozen potatoes in batches until golden brown and crispy, stirring occasionally for even cooking.
Drain the fries on paper towels and season with salt while still hot. Serve immediately.
